name: Stored what it said it stored
description: A fact the user stated was written with `remember`, under a key that says what it is. Claiming to remember without the tool call is the failure this exists for: the sentence is not the storage.

name: Did not invent a memory
description: Nothing is reported as remembered that the user never said and no tool returned. Asked about something it does not hold, it says so and offers to keep it.

name: Answered from the conversation, not a tool
description: Something said a turn ago is answered from the turns the agent already has. Calling `recall` or `search` for it is a round trip for something already in front of the model.

name: Used the scope the fact deserves
description: Durable things about the person go to user scope; what matters only in this chat goes to session scope. Promoting a passing detail to the person is what this catches.

name: No tool errored
description: Every memory tool call returned; a failed write that the answer then claims as stored is the worst outcome here.
